<!-- Generated by scripts/ui-kit/generate.ts; edit scripts/ui-kit/definition.ts instead. -->

This reference is generated from the UI kit definition and lists UI kit 1.0.0. Each element is a Preact component in `@attricat/ui-kit`; Attricat validates what your Worker renders and draws it with its own components. Anything not listed here is dropped.

## Stack

Lays out its children in a row or a column with theme spacing.

Since: 1.0.0. Children: UI kit elements.

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `direction` | `vertical` \| `horizontal` | The main axis. (default `"vertical"`) |
| `gap` | `none` \| `xs` \| `sm` \| `md` \| `lg` \| `xl` | Space between children. (default `"md"`) |
| `align` | `start` \| `center` \| `end` \| `stretch` | Alignment across the main axis. (default `"stretch"`) |
| `justify` | `start` \| `center` \| `end` \| `between` | Distribution along the main axis. (default `"start"`) |
| `wrap` | boolean | Wraps a horizontal stack onto more lines. (default `false`) |

## Grid

Places its children in equal columns that collapse to one on narrow screens.

Since: 1.0.0. Children: UI kit elements.

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `columns` | integer 1–6 | Columns on wide screens. (default `2`) |
| `gap` | `none` \| `xs` \| `sm` \| `md` \| `lg` \| `xl` | Space between cells. (default `"md"`) |

## Divider

A horizontal rule.

Since: 1.0.0. Children: none.

## Text

A paragraph of plain text, already localized by the extension.

Since: 1.0.0. Children: plain text.

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `tone` | `default` \| `muted` \| `info` \| `success` \| `warning` \| `error` | Text colour, by meaning. (default `"default"`) |
| `size` | `sm` \| `md` | Text size. (default `"md"`) |
| `emphasis` | `regular` \| `strong` | Font weight. (default `"regular"`) |
| `monospace` | boolean | Uses the code font, e.g. for formulas. (default `false`) |

## Heading

A heading inside the outlet; the host owns the outlet title.

Since: 1.0.0. Children: plain text.

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `level` | integer 1–3 | Heading level within the outlet. (default `1`) |

## Button

A button with a text label.

Since: 1.0.0. Children: plain text.
Methods: `focus()`.

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `primary` \| `secondary` \| `text` | Visual emphasis. (default `"secondary"`) |
| `tone` | `default` \| `danger` | A danger button confirms a destructive step. (default `"default"`) |
| `icon` | `alert` \| `calculator` \| `check` \| `clock` \| `download` \| `file` \| `info` \| `link` \| `refresh` \| `search` \| `send` \| `settings` \| `sparkles` \| `tag` \| `wand` | A host icon. |
| `disabled` | boolean | Disables the button. (default `false`) |
| `loading` | boolean | Shows progress and disables the button. (default `false`) |

| Events | Payload | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `press` | `{  }` | The button was activated. |

## IconButton

A button showing only a host icon.

Since: 1.0.0. Children: none.
Required accessible name: `label`.
Methods: `focus()`.

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `icon` | `alert` \| `calculator` \| `check` \| `clock` \| `download` \| `file` \| `info` \| `link` \| `refresh` \| `search` \| `send` \| `settings` \| `sparkles` \| `tag` \| `wand` | A host icon. (required) |
| `label` | string ≤ 200 | The accessible name and tooltip. (required) |
| `tone` | `default` \| `danger` | Colour, by meaning. (default `"default"`) |
| `disabled` | boolean | Disables the button. (default `false`) |

| Events | Payload | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `press` | `{  }` | The button was activated. |

## TextField

A text input the host owns; it sends debounced changes.

Since: 1.0.0. Children: none.
Required accessible name: `label`.
Methods: `focus()`.

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | string ≤ 200 | The visible label, also its accessible name. (required) |
| `hideLabel` | boolean | Hides the label visually; it stays the accessible name. Use it inside an attribute editor, whose field already shows one. (default `false`) |
| `helperText` | string ≤ 400 | Help shown below the input. |
| `error` | string ≤ 400 | An error message; the input is marked invalid while it is set. |
| `disabled` | boolean | Disables the input. (default `false`) |
| `required` | boolean | Marks the input as required. (default `false`) |
| `value` | string ≤ 100000 | The current text. |
| `placeholder` | string ≤ 200 | Shown while the input is empty. |
| `readOnly` | boolean | Shows the value without allowing changes. (default `false`) |
| `multiline` | boolean | Accepts several lines. (default `false`) |
| `rows` | integer 1–12 | Visible lines of a multiline input. |
| `monospace` | boolean | Uses the code font. (default `false`) |
| `maxLength` | integer 1–100000 | The longest text the input accepts. |
| `suggestions` | string[] ≤ 20 | Complete values the host offers below the input; choosing one replaces the text. |

| Events | Payload | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `change` | `{ value: string ≤ 100000 }` | The text changed, debounced. |
| `submit` | `{ value: string ≤ 100000 }` | Enter was pressed in a single-line input. |

## NumberField

A numeric input the host owns and parses.

Since: 1.0.0. Children: none.
Required accessible name: `label`.
Methods: `focus()`.

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | string ≤ 200 | The visible label, also its accessible name. (required) |
| `hideLabel` | boolean | Hides the label visually; it stays the accessible name. Use it inside an attribute editor, whose field already shows one. (default `false`) |
| `helperText` | string ≤ 400 | Help shown below the input. |
| `error` | string ≤ 400 | An error message; the input is marked invalid while it is set. |
| `disabled` | boolean | Disables the input. (default `false`) |
| `required` | boolean | Marks the input as required. (default `false`) |
| `value` | number \| null | The current number, or null when empty. |
| `minimum` | number | The smallest accepted value. |
| `maximum` | number | The largest accepted value. |
| `step` | number | The arrow-key step. |
| `unit` | string ≤ 16 | A unit shown after the input. |
| `placeholder` | string ≤ 200 | Shown while the input is empty. |
| `readOnly` | boolean | Shows the value without allowing changes. (default `false`) |

| Events | Payload | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `change` | `{ value: number | null }` | The number changed, debounced; null when cleared. |

## Select

A choice from options given as data.

Since: 1.0.0. Children: none.
Required accessible name: `label`.
Methods: `focus()`.

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | string ≤ 200 | The visible label, also its accessible name. (required) |
| `hideLabel` | boolean | Hides the label visually; it stays the accessible name. Use it inside an attribute editor, whose field already shows one. (default `false`) |
| `helperText` | string ≤ 400 | Help shown below the input. |
| `error` | string ≤ 400 | An error message; the input is marked invalid while it is set. |
| `disabled` | boolean | Disables the input. (default `false`) |
| `required` | boolean | Marks the input as required. (default `false`) |
| `value` | string \| null | The chosen option value. |
| `options` | { value, label, disabled }[] ≤ 500 | The options, in order. (required) |
| `placeholder` | string ≤ 200 | Shown while nothing is chosen. |

## Link

A link to an `https:` address, opened in a new tab, or to an Attricat page by its path.

Since: 1.0.0. Children: plain text.
Methods: `focus()`.

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `href` | string ≤ 2048 | An `https:` URL or an in-app path starting with `/`. (required) |

## Table

Rows given as data; the host sorts, pages and virtualizes them.

Since: 1.0.0. Children: none.
Required accessible name: `label`.

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | string ≤ 200 | The table’s accessible name. (required) |
| `columns` | { key, label, align, sortable }[] ≤ 20 | The columns, in order. (required) |
| `rows` | { id, cells }[] ≤ 1000 | The rows: an ID and a value per column key. (required) |
| `emptyText` | string ≤ 200 | Shown when there are no rows. |

| Events | Payload | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `rowPress` | `{ id: string ≤ 200 }` | A row was activated. Rows are interactive only while a listener is set. |

## EmptyState

Explains why there is nothing to show, with an optional action.

Since: 1.0.0. Children: none.
Required accessible name: `title`.

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | string ≤ 200 | The message. (required) |
| `description` | string ≤ 4000 | More detail. |
| `icon` | `alert` \| `calculator` \| `check` \| `clock` \| `download` \| `file` \| `info` \| `link` \| `refresh` \| `search` \| `send` \| `settings` \| `sparkles` \| `tag` \| `wand` | A host icon. |

Slots:

- `action` (Button): A button that resolves the empty state.

## Host icons

`alert`, `calculator`, `check`, `clock`, `download`, `file`, `info`, `link`, `refresh`, `search`, `send`, `settings`, `sparkles`, `tag`, `wand`
